name: skill-vetter
description: Security-first skill vetting for AI agents. Use before installing any skill from ClawdHub, GitHub, or other sources. Checks for red flags, permission scope, and suspicious patterns.
descriptionZh: AI智能体技能安全预审工具。安装ClawdHub、GitHub等来源技能前，检查风险信号、权限范围及可疑模式。

en.tagline: Security checks before installing an AI agent skill
en.summary: skill-vetter is a vetting protocol for AI agent skills. It gives the agent a fixed set of checks to run before installing a skill from ClawdHub, GitHub, or another source. The result is a written report with red flags, required permissions, a risk level, and a verdict.
problem: Agent skills run code with the agent's access. A skill can read credential files, send data to outside servers, or run obfuscated code.
Without a fixed check, the decision to install depends on what the agent or user happens to notice. This skill runs the same checks each time and records the results.
fit: Installing a skill from ClawdHub, GitHub, or another agent
Reviewing unknown code before the agent runs it
Keeping a written record of why a skill was or was not installed
unfit: Automatic code scanning, since the skill is a manual checklist for the agent
Reviewing a skill that is already installed and running
steps: Check the source by confirming where the skill came from, who wrote it, and when it was last updated.
Read every file in the skill and reject it on sight if it has red flags such as unknown URLs, credential requests, base64 decoding, or obfuscated code.
List the files it reads and writes, the commands it runs, and any network access, and check that this scope fits its stated purpose.
Assign a risk level from low to extreme; medium and above need a full code review, high needs human approval, and extreme is not installed.
Write a vetting report with red flags, permissions, risk level, verdict, and notes.
Record what was vetted so the decision can be checked later.

zh.tagline: 安装智能体技能前的安全审查
zh.summary: skill-vetter 是一套用于审查 AI 智能体技能的流程。它让智能体在从 ClawdHub、GitHub 或其他来源安装技能前，按固定清单逐项检查。检查结束后会生成一份书面报告，包含风险信号、所需权限、风险等级和结论。
problem: 智能体技能会以智能体的权限运行代码。技能可能读取凭证文件、把数据发送到外部服务器，或运行经过混淆的代码。
如果没有固定的检查步骤，是否安装就取决于智能体或用户当时注意到了什么。这个技能每次都执行相同的检查，并保存结果。
fit: 从 ClawdHub、GitHub 或其他智能体处安装技能
在智能体运行陌生代码之前进行审查
留存书面记录，说明技能为何被安装或被拒绝
unfit: 自动化代码扫描，因为它本质上是供智能体手动执行的检查清单
审查已经安装并正在运行的技能
steps: 检查来源，确认技能来自哪里、由谁编写、最近一次更新时间。
阅读技能中的每个文件，如果发现未知 URL、索取凭证、base64 解码或混淆代码等风险信号，立即拒绝。
列出技能读取和写入的文件、运行的命令以及所需的网络访问，并确认这些范围与其声明的用途相符。
评定风险等级，从低到极高。中等及以上需要完整代码审查，高等级需要人工批准，极高等级不予安装。
撰写审查报告，包括风险信号、权限、风险等级、结论和备注。
记录已审查的内容，便于日后核查该决定。
